instruction: A candid outdoor photograph with a medium full shot captures a couple on a rocky coastal shore under an overcast sky. The man in the blue puffer vest (R1) walks forward in the center foreground, smiling slightly. The woman in the striped sweater (R2) piggybacks on his back, her arms wrapped around his neck as she smiles towards the right. The man supports her legs as they move together. The background shows calm sea water under a grey sky. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a cool-toned, natural atmosphere.
